slip_allowed.what: a truth pair counts as found when an unused prediction has both indices within 1; this is the metric that must be >= the exact F1

shifted_prediction.what: the prediction is moved by delta and scored exactly; a sensitivity check that the indices are exact, NOT a tolerance metric

pseudoknot_policy: no removal: true pairs are scored as given, including crossing ones; predictions are always non-crossing, so a pseudoknotted true pair that is predicted in the wrong register counts as FP+FN. No separate pseudoknot document exists; this records the implemented behaviour.
